reserveReview.rationale: The September 29 captured Sky book reports canonical Ethereum USDC in the verified LitePSM pocket. Both DAI and USDS share this book. The measured $4,255,200,267.580757 divided by captured total group debt $10,751,404,484 is 39.578087%. The rounded stablecoins group share is 39.4%; its 0.178087 percentage-point excess falls inside the explicitly reviewed 0.25-point cross-endpoint timing/rounding band, so the reviewed USDC share is capped to the group share and the measured stock remains separate metadata. The zero keyed residual is a classification row, not a holding. Positive unexplained remainders and failed reconciliations retain the existing very-low PSM-pool risk, without an inferred constituent identity. Allocators remain classified at their deployed-strategy failure domain.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: September 29 captured group-debt shares; canonical gem() and measured LitePSM USDC pocket balance with explicit reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Unexplained positive PSM remainders stay unlinked; excess above 0.25 percentage points fails the split closed. Allocator groups have no invented tracked-token look-through weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Grove is a Sky Agent allocation into institutional-credit strategies, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Spark is an allocator and lending-protocol position with multiple deployment counterparties, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Obex is an Agent allocation across supported institutional stablecoin projects rather than one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Core bucket is a multi-collateral crypto-vault pool, not one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Staking Engine bucket is collateralized by SKY positions in LockStake Engine vaults, not by another tracked stablecoin.
The legacy RWA bucket represents external legal structures and obligors rather than a direct tracked-stablecoin dependency.
Osero is a Sky allocator position with mutable deployed strategies rather than one direct tracked-stablecoin reserve asset.
